replication.reason_numeric_minimum_null: Issue #49 requires a source-disjoint replication set frozen before outcomes but does not authorize inventing a replication N. The eventual manifest must freeze its exact N before predictions.

external_gold.rule: ORION authors/rules do not generate gold; disagreements remain recorded and unresolved authority is CANNOT_CHECK

strongest_incomplete_donor_rule: select/freeze the strongest incomplete donor identity on development material before primary/replication gold; no protected-result reselection
information_equivalent_control: typed donor receives exactly the candidate target-relevant scientific coordinates and terminal alphabet; any mismatch invalidates the comparison

analysis_gate.ideal_typed_donor: exact candidate tie on every information-equivalent packet
analysis_gate.false_promotion: paired improvement I(strongest incomplete donor false promotion) - I(candidate false promotion), deterministic 10000-resample packet bootstrap 95% lower bound > 0
analysis_gate.valid_admission: candidate valid-admission rate is no more than 0.02 below the best safe comparator
analysis_gate.safe_comparator_definition: non-candidate arm with zero false scientific promotions among adjudicable primary packets; choose the highest valid-admission rate, ties by frozen baseline order
analysis_gate.selective_revalidation: 1 - sum(candidate charged recheck work)/sum(global-recheck work) >= 0.25 AND candidate post-revalidation validity rate >= global-recheck validity rate
analysis_gate.strata: mean paired false-promotion improvement > 0 in all three primary strata
analysis_gate.replication: source-disjoint replication mean paired false-promotion improvement > 0

leakage_guards: all candidate/baseline predictions sealed before adjudication reveal
identical candidate-visible packet hash for information-matched arms
scientific gold absent from candidate-visible features
primary and replication source lineages disjoint
typed donor has neither extra information nor missing candidate information
negative_result_policy: A false-promotion null, admission tradeoff, revalidation-savings failure, stratum heterogeneity, replication reversal, donor mismatch or CANNOT_CHECK is retained. Do not reinterpret same-programme conformance as external generality.
